title: Spiral Minds Vortex
description: Four stylized female profiles in yellow, purple, green and lavender face left, their hair composed of intricate hypnotic spirals and concentric circles. They are arranged in a circular formation within a swirling cosmic vortex of blended purple, teal, magenta and gold brushstrokes.
prompt: Psychedelic surreal painting featuring four stylized female profiles arranged in a circular formation facing left, their hair transformed into intricate hypnotic spirals and concentric circles in green, blue and black. The figures are set against a dynamic swirling vortex background of blended magenta, purple, teal and gold brushstrokes with visible texture. Symbolic, mystical atmosphere with high contrast and flowing organic patterns.
